services.desc: At Bear Creek Outfitters, we have over 3 decades of experience of fly fishing in Southeast, Alaska and all over the world. We put together a comprehensive list of recommended fly fishing gear for Juneau, Alaska - our home. For us, packing light is always the goal, but sometimes not practical when fishing in remote parts of the world. Therefore, we’ve made this list easy to use depending on how much gear you want to bring to Alaska! Shameless self-promotion! There’s nothing better than hiring a quality outfitter to take you fishing and outfit you with all the best gear!
